invariants.rationale: The method constructs and returns a new HashMap, which is never null.
The globalStat is always newly created and never null.
result.getRight() (globalStat) is distinct from any WorkloadStat in the partition map; a new WorkloadStat is created for globalStat and for each partition.
partitionPathStatMap is empty if and only if inputRecords is empty.
There is at most one partitionPathStatMap entry per unique (partitionPath, currentLocation); the number of unique keys cannot exceed the number of records.
